name: app-download-qr
title: App download with QR
description: Get the app on your phone: store buttons, a QR code for desktop visitors and a 'text me the link' field.
docs: Pass title, description, stores (a name and an href, with an optional caption and icon), qr and onSendLink. The store buttons are drawn in the house style, not as copied badges; the icon and the small line follow the store's name unless you pass your own. qr is the SVG or image from your generator, given an accessible name; it sits on a white tile so it scans in both themes. onSendLink receives the number in international form ('+31612345678'), the field starts on defaultCountry, and Link sent is a status message that takes focus. A phone or tablet (no hover, a coarse pointer) sees only the store buttons: the QR code and the text field are hidden by a media query on hover and pointer, not by width, so a narrow desktop window still gets them. rating is a value, a count and an optional source, written in locale, with a single rating in the singular. defaultStatus and defaultPhone start the text path as sent. labels translates every fixed word.
